authHeaderPattern.note: Both docs pages independently state the same Authorization header format for authenticated V3 API calls.

apiVersioningStrategy.note: basePath is a fixed literal segment ("/v3") on every path in the spec -- confirms url-path versioning. info.version (3.0.161) is the SPEC document's own version, not a URL-visible API version.

errorResponseShape.note: Full scan of every operation's declared "responses" keys in the saved OpenAPI spec (98 paths). errorCodesObserved lists every distinct >=400 status code documented anywhere in the spec.
